C-EMBED-DROPBOX-APP-KEY.Summary: Embed the public Dropbox app key in GoReleaser binaries using a GitHub Actions repository variable and Go linker flags, retaining runtime configuration for development.

Goals.Goal: Released executables can link Dropbox without users exporting an app key. Wire the existing release workflow through GoReleaser to a string variable in package main.

Constraints.Constraint: Read the build value from vars.DROPBOX_APP_KEY through workflow env; fail before release when missing. Keep the existing release trigger, build matrix, token and permissions.
A nonempty trimmed runtime DROPBOX_APP_KEY overrides the embedded default. Empty development builds retain optional Dropbox setup and existing missing-configuration handling.
Embed only the public app key. Do not embed user access/refresh tokens or app secrets. Preserve current application behavior and the user database.
Follow existing Go formatting; do not add committed automated tests. Preserve git staging and execute sequentially.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Do not publish a release, push a tag, edit repository settings, install permanent tools, or change OAuth/database behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A package-main string variable accepts -X main.dropboxAppKey=<value>; bootstrap passes the resolved runtime override or embedded default to NewLinker.
The workflow exposes vars.DROPBOX_APP_KEY to GoReleaser, checks it before releasing, and .goreleaser.yaml passes it with -X to all configured builds.
README documents the repository variable location, release behavior, runtime override and local build command. Current deployment and graph/verification state match the release pipeline.

Build and vet pass; temporary probes verify embedded/default/override/empty behavior and a real CLI binary links with a placeholder key without opening the real database. Final GRACE validation precedes archiving under existing user authorization.

Assumptions.Assumption: The workflow question requests implementation of embedding into the workflow just added. Use a repository configuration variable because the app key is public, as established in the conversation.
The prior request to archive completed GRACE work and sequential implementation preference persist.
